biggest_catch: Earnings are tiny per minute of play — this is a hours-for-a-few-dollars grind, not a $5/hour job — and the company's own fine print says advertised earning amounts are for illustration and actual earnings may be smaller. The Play Games playtime rewards require the Lootup Android app specifically.
catches: Variable-work catch: per-minute/per-task rewards are tiny — expect many hours of playtime for a few dollars, and game offers rotate or disappear without notice.

Lootup's own disclaimer: 'any amounts of earnings, rewards, coins and/or prizes shown in our advertisements and/or marketing materials... are for illustration purposes only and may not reflect the actual earnings to be achieved within our app.'
Playtime Rewards (get paid per minute playing games) are only available in the Lootup Android app after allowing it to track your mobile gaming stats — not on the website.
The $5 bonus only triggers when you earn at least $10 within 30 days of registration; miss the window and you get $0.
Redemption options include PayPal cash, gift cards, and crypto via BitPay — availability of specific rewards is 'subject to availability' per the company.
Survey payouts cap 'up to $5 per completion' per the company — most pay less.

steps: Go to https://lootup.me/ and create your free Lootup account.
Install the free Lootup Android app from Google Play and sign in with the same account.
In the app, open the Play Games environment and allow the app to track your mobile gaming stats — this is what pays you per minute of play.
Play the featured games offered to you; you earn points for your playtime (the company's own guide notes switching between games can be more profitable than sticking to one).
Track your points balance in the app; redeem from $1.00 for PayPal cash, gift cards, or crypto via BitPay.
If you are in your first 30 days, push to earn at least $10 — that triggers the $5 bonus the company advertises.
timing: Points redeem from $1.00 as earned ('instant rewards for completing tasks' per the company); the $5 bonus pays after earning $10 within 30 days of registration.
